name: Chip/Normal
description:
**Overview:** A compact, interactive tag representing a filter option, input value, or attribute that users can select or deselect.

**Use Cases:**
- ✅ Use as multi-select filter chips on search or list pages (e.g., category filters).
- ✅ Use to show applied filters or selected tags with a remove (×) action.
- ❌ DO NOT use as a navigation link — use Tabs or Buttons.
- ❌ DO NOT use for long text that wraps across lines.
- ❌ DO NOT use as a read-only label — use Tag instead.

**Props / Variants:** State (Default/Selected/Disabled), Leading Icon, Trailing Icon/Close, Size.

**Original Notes:** Compact interactive tag for filter options and attribute values.

name: Chip/Advanced
description:
**Overview:** An expanded chip variant supporting dropdown or editable value interactions, allowing users to set or change filter parameters inline.

**Use Cases:**
- ✅ Use for dynamic filter chips that open a popover to change their value (e.g., "Status: Active" → click to change).
- ✅ Use in complex query builders or advanced filter panels.
- ❌ DO NOT use when a simple static chip suffices — use Chip/Normal.
- ❌ DO NOT use for read-only labels — use Tag.

**Props / Variants:** State, Type, Dropdown, Count, Value.

**Original Notes:** Advanced interactive chip for editable filter and attribute controls.

name: Chip/Number-Only
description:
**Overview:** A minimal chip displaying only a numeric value, used for counts, rankings, or quantities in compact contexts.

**Use Cases:**
- ✅ Use to show item counts in compact list headers or category labels.
- ✅ Use for quantity indicators in carts, selection states, or step counts.
- ❌ DO NOT use for status labels — use Badge.
- ❌ DO NOT use when a text label alongside the number adds necessary context — use Chip/Normal.

**Props / Variants:** Count, Size, Theme.

**Original Notes:** Numeric-only compact indicator for counts or rankings.

name: Popover/Bulk-Action
description:
**Overview:** A compact contextual action popover triggered on long-press or selection of a canvas or content element, providing quick access to format, edit, or manipulate actions.

**Use Cases:**
- ✅ Use for text selection format actions (Bold, Italic, Link, Comment).
- ✅ Use for element-level quick actions on a canvas, board, or list item (Edit, Duplicate, Delete, Move).
- ❌ DO NOT use for global navigation or page-level actions — use a Sidebar or Toolbar.
- ❌ DO NOT exceed 5–6 action icons — use a full context menu or side panel for more complex operations.

**Props / Variants:** Action Icons (configurable), Position (Top/Bottom of selection).

**Original Notes:** Contextual quick-action popover for selected canvas or content elements. Use for format text selection, edit tool, canvas tool interactions.
